title: Companion Learn Catalog
description: Gallery of skilled Kyberion usage patterns and beginner guides for Presence Studio /learn.

gallery.title: Meeting facilitator
gallery.summary: Capture notes, record minutes, and hand off follow-ups without leaving the companion workbench.
gallery.try_hint: Open Work → Meeting notepad (port 8148) or run pnpm meeting:participate --help

gallery.title: Narrated report
gallery.summary: Generate a report summary and optional audio/video artifacts from a governed pipeline.

gallery.title: Browser research
gallery.summary: Explore a page, capture state, and produce a browser artifact with persona-guided research.

gallery.title: Personal capture pads
gallery.summary: Local pads for memory, screenshots, clipboard, desk, and docs — capture then hand off.

gallery.title: Secretary workbench
gallery.summary: Proposal-only capture with governed email draft and calendar approve → create.

guides.title: First win in one sitting
steps: Open this Companion Hub and pick Learn or Work.
Run the browser smoke path from docs/QUICKSTART.md.
Capture one real outcome (minutes, report, or pad handoff).

guides.title: Pick an outcome, not a subsystem
steps: Choose Meeting, Report, or Browser research from USE_CASE_QUICKSTARTS.
Copy the start command from the matching gallery card.
When stuck, return here and open Discover for a requirements walkthrough.

guides.title: Connect external services
steps: From the Hub, open Connect (Concierge setup).
Click a service icon and complete OAuth in the browser.
Confirm the Connected chip before using service-actuator workflows.
